# The binary plans matrix targets, and groups with arguments.
bit --version
stdout '\Abit \d'

bit --plan ...
stdout 'greet\["a"\]'
stdout 'greet\["b"\]'

bit --plan release name=b
stdout 'publish\(name="b"\)'

-- BUILD.bit --
let names = ["a", "b"]

# Greet each name.
greet[name = names] = exec {
  command = "echo hello #{name}"
}

# Publish one name.
publish(name : string) = exec {
  command = "echo publish #{name}"
  depends_on = [greet]
}

# Greet everyone.
group default = [greet]

# Greet everyone and publish a name.
group release(name : string = "a") = [publish(name = name)]
